d:
Desi Melodies is proud to present "Shikari", a cross-border anthem in a high-energy fusion of rap, hip-hop, and Punjabi grit. Sultaan, the heavyweight force, commands the mic. Faris Shafi, Pakistan’s lyrical maverick, drops an elite, razor-sharp feature. And Avvy Sra delivers a cinematic, hard-hitting beat built for the culture.
Singer & Composer - Sultaan
Featuring - Faris Shafi
Music Producer - Avvy Sra
Lyricists - Sultaan, Faris Shafi
Female Lead - Anza Mehmood
Director – Arvvindr S Khaira
Co-Producers - Romeo, Jeremiah “Chubs” Akers, Peter Zawalski
